name: ai-identifier-translator
description: Read source code with non-English identifiers displayed in English, without ever modifying the file on disk. Local LLM only, no cloud calls.

commands.title: AI Identifier Translator: Translate Active File Now
AI Identifier Translator: Clear Cache for This Repository
AI Identifier Translator: Show Original Identifier Under Cursor
AI Identifier Translator: Enter Pro License Key

aiIdentifierTranslator.model.description: Ollama model tag used for identifier translation.

aiIdentifierTranslator.ollamaEndpoint.description: Local Ollama server endpoint. Never sent over the network beyond localhost.

aiIdentifierTranslator.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for the translation model.

aiIdentifierTranslator.maxContextTokens.description: Maximum context window used per translation request.

aiIdentifierTranslator.automaticTranslat.description: Automatically translate visible identifiers as you scroll/open files. Disable to translate only on manual command.

aiIdentifierTranslator.maxConcurrentTran.description: Maximum concurrent requests to the local Ollama server.

aiIdentifierTranslator.cacheLocation.description: Directory for the per-repository SQLite cache. Empty = use VS Code global storage path.

aiIdentifierTranslator.decorationColor.description: Color used to render translated (virtual) identifiers, to distinguish them from real source text.

aiIdentifierTranslator.lowConfidenceColo.description: Color used for fallback/low-confidence translations (e.g. transliteration fallback).
